selection_method.topic_rule: Scientific, commercial, sports, weather/environmental-observation and cultural outcomes; exclude political-policy, legislative, electoral, diplomatic, regulatory-approval and governmental-structure outcomes, including any such condition inside a tuple. selection_method.semantic_rule: Exclude clear changed date windows, quantities, quantifiers, non-complementary conditions or contradictory event predicates. Do not exclude solely for different reporting boilerplate.

semantic_caveats.detail: This is a fixed subset of the original first30-per-check cohort, with uneven check counts and no eligible CondCond tuple. It is not a replacement claim about all possible science/business/culture questions.
Titles alone are insufficient. Resolution bodies retain date windows, evidence requirements and hypothetical conditions. Source texts have not been rewritten.

Remaining conditional questions use hypothetical premises, and some have N/A wording when a premise is not observed. A runner must elicit the conditional probability under the stated supposition, never treat it as the joint event or convert N/A/ABSTAIN to a number.

Verification wording sometimes uses awkward no-event confirmations, ambiguous source qualifiers, or shorthand. These are recorded as limitations rather than automatically excluding a tuple solely because reporting boilerplate differs. This review is not a formal proof that every conceivable reading is equivalent.

Terms such as machine learning company, nuclear-powered robotic system, AI credited with discovery, quantum-computing central theme and genetic R&D expenditure remain broad and may induce interpretation differences. No selective prompt clarification was applied.
Many questions cover October 1, 2024 through 2028, so runs in 2026 combine elapsed and future periods. No truth labels or forecasts were generated in this review.

Deforestation questions specify measured environmental outcomes verified by INPE, without requiring a government policy decision. Geographic names and government data sources alone are not topic exclusions.

Space-agency launches, landings and named technical partnership announcements remain eligible where all tuple components are scientific milestones and contain no political-policy condition. FDA approvals and government institution/policy rollouts are outside the scope.

Every compared configuration must use this same tuple/proposition manifest. Missing or abstained readouts must remain visible. Recomputing historical rows on this subset may require available historical proposition-level readouts; full-cohort historical scores cannot silently be compared with subset scores.
